limitations: This is not the entire B125 acceptance (including an exhaustive independent RNG guarantee) and does not close B125/LA-014/LA-015.
Custom owner validators are trusted contracts; arbitrary runtime replacement/monkeypatching is outside the guarantee.
Deterministic accumulator is a protocol witness, not scientific/production evaluator evidence.
NN update-owned direct warm state has no persisted Adapter resume admission; numerical GP, served/default caller, and production data criteria remain separately scoped.
Full 17,350-path input/origin table is preserved as ignored local raw data, not Git available; full-input portability and P41 remain not_established.
verification_performed_by_reviewer: Read-only source, exact source/tree lineage, source blob identity, committed handoff, JUnit, removal output, and transport/independent review receipts. No Python tests or installs run.
